name: secure-notes
description: Secure Notes & To-Do — microservice monorepo (Express + TypeScript)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages --if-present && npm run build -w apps --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages --if-present && npm run typecheck -w apps --if-present
scripts.verify:workspace: node -e "const s=require('@secure-notes/shared');for(const k of ['AppError','errorHandler','asyncHandler','validate','requireUser','requireRole','logger','parsePagination','paginated'])if(!s[k])throw new Error('missing export: '+k);console.log('shared-ok')"
